neighbours.label: formal order/structure relations in math and query code (partial orders, bounds, LEFT joins), not everyday 'left' or ordering
fire: In order theory, the subset relation on a power set is a partial order, and every chain has an upper bound.
We say the relation is reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive, which makes it a partial order on the set.
Under divisibility, 1 is the least element of the natural numbers and 0 is the greatest.
A poset in which any two elements have a greatest lower bound is called a meet-semilattice.

SELECT p.name, s.total
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id

SELECT u.email FROM users u
  left join profiles pr on pr.user_id = u.id
  where pr.id is null
